ecological_primary_question: Across six overlapping Azorean islands, does higher same-island Jaccard similarity of IDENTIFIED introduced Coleoptera in independently sampled 1-hour ruderal sites accompany stronger (more negative) decades-long native-forest beetle spatial Simpson beta change in the SEPARATE BALA observations?

frozen_BALA_island_forest_response.response_direction: forest homogenization stronger as original BALA Simpson B3−B1 becomes more negative; for Spearman calculate positive habitat-pressure relation against y=−BALA forest delta
frozen_BALA_island_forest_response.site_overlap: Six island contexts matched ONLY by island code, not by physical site, habitat or sampling method.

taxon_guild_and_origin.species_identity: Normalize original PRIBES scientificName by Unicode NFKD and whitespace/casefold only, retain operational original taxon identity; no synonym repair or geographic reclassification based on BALA outcomes
taxon_guild_and_origin.status_normalization: casefold, underscore/hyphen to spaces, collapse whitespace; statuses not matching above classes become UNKNOWN not source-side introduced, no postvalue relabel
taxon_guild_and_origin.negative_control_pool: native and endemic identified Beetle taxa combined, under same site/effort/rank rules
taxon_guild_and_origin.conflicting_origin_per_island_same_scien: Scientific STOP of whole cross-source association; never resolve to the favorable one
taxon_guild_and_origin.morphospecies_not_identified: Drop taxonRank non-species/subspecies, even if source named and common; summarize coverage rather than treating newly arrived unknown morphospecies as introduced.

source_site_index.one_hour_sample_source_identity: Same v1.322 original source Event and site selection with lexicographic original core ID per unique normalized island+locationID
source_site_index.independent_source_site: Original PRIBES standardized one-hour vegetation-beating site; not trap event, individual specimen, native forest site or species
source_site_index.source_sites_zero_introduced: Retain site in original survey denominator and report n. For introduced site-pair Jaccard, require BOTH sampled sites have ≥1 recognized introduced taxon, rather than defining two empty sites as 100% similar.
source_site_index.Jaccard: For any two nonempty site-specific introduced Beetle source species sets A and B, Jaccard similarity = |A∩B|/|A∪B|, with zero when union nonempty and intersection empty.
source_site_index.island_predictor: Unweighted mean Jaccard similarity across all source within-island pairs of nonempty introduced beetle sites. This is a pairwise descriptive source pool measure, not a count of independently replicated site-pairs.
source_site_index.source_island_admission: For each of FAI/FLO/PIC/TER/SMG/SMR require at least four independent 1-hour PRIBES sites with ≥1 IDENTIFIED introduced Beetle taxon and ≥2 different introduced taxa pooled across all original sites. If ANY one island fails, no six-island association is scored. Island source counts reported as scientific STOP, no subset rescue.

cross_source_test.primary_predictor: introduced Coleoptera within-island source-site Jaccard similarity
cross_source_test.primary_response: negative of BALA original source-locked within-island Beetle Simpson spatial delta B3−B1
cross_source_test.correlation: Spearman with average ranks on ties, no fitted slopes or estimated p from 72 site pseudo-replicates
cross_source_test.null_exact: All 6! = 720 complete permutations of the six immutable BALA island outcome labels, no bootstrap of PRIBES source sites, two-tailed r shown and one-sided nonnegative association p>=observed counted over 720 as predeclared
cross_source_test.direction_if_positive: More introduced source-site similarity accompanies stronger BALA forest beetle homogenization. Exploratory source-pool compatibility, NOT proven dispersal or driver.
cross_source_test.native_negative_control: Using same PRIBES original identified native/endemic Coleoptera site Jaccard (identical >=4 nonempty site support), calculate exact 6-island Spearman against same BALA y. If native correlation >= introduced, NOT specific introduced pressure. If control source fails do not claim specificity.
cross_source_test.secondary_spider: Source introduced Araneae same Jaccard and island controls, report only if six-island source min support; not substitute for primary failure.
cross_source_test.temporal_survey_year_confound: Report Spearman of source island survey calendar year versus source introduced site-Jaccard and versus BALA forest homogenization. Each island was PRIBES sampled in one different calendar year, so this is a major unresolved competing explanation. Do not fit 3-variable model on n=6.
cross_source_test.threshold_for_strong_claim: No causal strong claim under any result; report positive exploratory descriptive support only if r>0, exact one-sided permutation p<0.05, and source native negative-control r is weaker; otherwise correlation is non-support/ambiguous. No post-outcome threshold recalibration.
cross_source_test.zero_data_policy: If any required source field, status, taxon or island-level n gate fails, primary rho=null/p=null; commit STOP and original source is closed, do not switch to all arthropods or lower minimum.

limitations: BALA forest transects were Pitfall-sampled (1997–2022) and PRIBES ruderal sites vegetation-beaten (2019–2025): different guild capture processes and asynchronous periods.
One PRIBES calendar year per island; geographic island and sampling year not separable observationally.
Separate PRIBES/BALA survey efforts and different species identification histories; source distribution is not measured immigrant flux into forest.
Only six island contexts and one archipelago; cannot establish general conservation priority ranking or causal source-sink rescue.
PRIBES 2026 authors already documented introduced species distributions and 61 new island records; that is prior art, not a new Structural result.
